You gain one of the following traits:

  • With proficiency in the Building Trade, when you are hitting a structure with a weapon attack, you can angle the impact in a way that is most likely to weaken its structural integrity. On a successful DC 12 Intelligence (Investigation) check, you permanently create a structural weakness and can immediately apply the Building Trade’s Destruct bonus to this attack.
  • With proficiency in the Pathfinding Trade, when you take the Explore Area rest action in a city, ruins, or other constructed environment, you have advantage on the associated skill check.
